title: Stock ledger
prompt: Implement `static int totalQuantity(java.util.List<Integer> quantities)` (sum of a List — generics in action) and `static java.util.Map<String, Integer> mergeStock(java.util.Map<String, Integer> a, java.util.Map<String, Integer> b)` returning a NEW map with quantities summed per key.

tests.name: list summation
tests.hint: for-each over the list; empty list sums to 0.

tests.name: map merging
tests.hint: Copy a, then add b's entries with getOrDefault.

tests.name: no mutation of inputs
tests.hint: Build a new map; never write into the parameters.
